title: The UK CMA opens an investigation into Microsoft over a potential consumer law breach involving users paying more to renew Microsoft 365 after it added Copilot (Upmanyu Trivedi/Bloomberg)
summary: Upmanyu Trivedi / Bloomberg: The UK CMA opens an investigation into Microsoft over a potential consumer law breach involving users paying more to renew Microsoft 365 after it added Copilot — The UK's consumer and antitrust watchdog is investigating whether Microsoft Corp. misled customers into paying …
